## Où j'en suis
Dashboard v2 is live behind `dashboards_v2` and the follow-up from Priya's #418 review is done: keyboard move/resize (Tab to focus, Enter to pick up, arrows to move/resize, Escape to cancel, aria-live announcements) plus a visible focus ring are in PR #423, open and awaiting Priya's review. A first attempt with dnd-kit conflicted with react-grid-layout (double event handling) and was removed in favor of a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook (commit 8f1a2c7). The staging flag is on for Zest Grocers; production stays off until Tom flips it himself the morning of the Nov 24 demo. The visx migration (#401) was closed for good — recharts stays. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3)

- [en-cours] PR #423 (keyboard move/resize + focus ring) open, waiting on Priya's review (source: ses-db-4, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Get #423 reviewed/merged, then Tom flips the production `dashboards_v2` flag himself the morning of the 24th Zest demo (source: d4-06, d4-07, src-pr418)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both libraries listen to the same events, every move applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes (source: d4-02)
- [décision] Custom keyboard handler, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts and close #401 — not worth +181 KB or rewriting 9 charts (source: c3-03, src-pr401)
- [décision] Staging flag on for zest-grocers only; production flipped by Tom the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: b2-04)
